# Completions API

> An OpenAI-compatible completions endpoint with automatic provider failover. Send a chat-completion request; the gateway tries each configured upstream provider in order and returns the first successful response.

## Base URL

The gateway speaks the OpenAI Chat Completions protocol. Point any OpenAI SDK or plain HTTP client at the server root, e.g. `http://localhost:8080/v1`.

## Authentication

Every request to the completions API must include an API key, passed as a Bearer token (or the `x-api-key` header):

```text
Authorization: Bearer sk-gw-...
```

API keys are created and revoked in the admin dashboard. Upstream provider API keys are configured on the server side and are never exposed to callers.

## Endpoints

- [Create chat completion](/v1/chat/completions): `POST /v1/chat/completions` — generate a chat completion. Supports streaming and non-streaming.
- [List models](/v1/models): `GET /v1/models` — list the models of all enabled providers.

## Chat Completions request

`POST /v1/chat/completions` accepts a JSON body in the OpenAI format:

```json
{
  "model": "gpt-4o-mini",
  "messages": [
    {"role": "system", "content": "You are a helpful assistant."},
    {"role": "user", "content": "Hello!"}
  ],
  "stream": false,
  "temperature": 0.7,
  "max_tokens": 256,
  "top_p": 1.0
}
```

### Request fields

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|-------|------|----------|-------------|
| `messages` | array | yes | Conversation history. Each item is `{"role": "user" \| "assistant" \| "system", "content": "..."}`. |
| `model` | string | no | Requested model id. Forwarded unchanged to wildcard providers (those with no fixed model). |
| `stream` | boolean | no | When `true`, the response is streamed as Server-Sent Events (default `false`). |
| `temperature` | number | no | Sampling temperature, typically 0–2. |
| `max_tokens` | integer | no | Maximum number of tokens to generate. |
| `max_completion_tokens` | integer | no | Alias for `max_tokens`. |
| `top_p` | number | no | Nucleus sampling probability. |

## Wildcard providers (aggregators)

A provider configured with **no fixed model** is a *wildcard*: whatever `model` you send in the request is forwarded to it unchanged. This is how you front an aggregator that exposes many models with a single provider entry, for example:

- **Hack Club AI** — base URL `https://ai.hackclub.com/proxy/v1`, type `openai`, no model
- **OpenRouter** — base URL `https://openrouter.ai/api/v1`, type `openai`, no model

With one wildcard entry you can call any model the aggregator supports (e.g. `openai/gpt-4o`, `anthropic/claude-sonnet-4-5`, `google/gemini-2.5-flash`) without adding a provider per model. In `GET /v1/models`, a wildcard provider is listed with the id `*`.

## Chat Completions response

Non-streaming responses are returned as a single JSON object:

```json
{
  "id": "chatcmpl-abc123",
  "object": "chat.completion",
  "created": 1720000000,
  "model": "gpt-4o-mini",
  "choices": [
    {
      "index": 0,
      "message": {"role": "assistant", "content": "Hi! How can I help?"},
      "finish_reason": "stop"
    }
  ],
  "usage": {"prompt_tokens": 12, "completion_tokens": 6, "total_tokens": 18}
}
```

## Streaming

When `"stream": true`, the response is `text/event-stream`. Each `data:` event carries one `chat.completion.chunk` object with a `delta`, and the stream ends with `data: [DONE]`:

```
data: {"id":"chatcmpl-abc123","object":"chat.completion.chunk","created":1720000000,"model":"gpt-4o-mini","choices":[{"index":0,"delta":{"role":"assistant","content":""},"finish_reason":null}]}

data: {"id":"chatcmpl-abc123","object":"chat.completion.chunk","created":1720000000,"model":"gpt-4o-mini","choices":[{"index":0,"delta":{"content":"Hi"},"finish_reason":null}]}

data: [DONE]
```

## Failover behavior

The gateway maintains an ordered list of providers. For each request it attempts the providers in order:

- The first provider that returns a successful (2xx) response wins; that response is returned to the caller.
- If a provider fails (network error, timeout, or non-2xx status), the gateway records the failure and tries the next provider.
- If every enabled provider fails, the gateway returns HTTP 502.

For non-streaming requests the gateway fails over fully. For streaming requests it fails over only if a provider fails before any data is sent; once a provider begins streaming, it is committed.

## Error responses

Errors use the OpenAI error shape:

```json
{"error": {"message": "all providers failed: ...", "type": "upstream_error", "code": 502}}
```

| Status | Meaning |
|--------|---------|
| 200 | Success. |
| 400 | Invalid request body (e.g. missing `messages`). |
| 401 | Missing or invalid API key. |
| 502 | All providers failed. |
| 503 | No enabled providers configured. |

## Examples

### curl

```bash
curl http://localhost:8080/v1/chat/completions \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"gpt-4o-mini","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"Hello!"}]}'
```

### OpenAI Python SDK

```python
from openai import OpenAI

client = OpenAI(base_url="http://localhost:8080/v1", api_key="sk-gw-...")

resp = client.chat.completions.create(
    model="gpt-4o-mini",
    messages=[{"role": "user", "content": "Hello!"}],
)
print(resp.choices[0].message.content)
```

### Streaming (curl)

```bash
curl -N http://localhost:8080/v1/chat/completions \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"gpt-4o-mini","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"Hello!"}],"stream":true}'
```
